paragraphs: Most engine suppliers sell you a used engine of unknown history and hope it matches. We do it differently.

We rebuild the engine your Range Rover already has - strip it down, pressure-test it, and replace every worn or damaged component with new OEM parts: timing chains, injector seals, EGR components, turbo parts and gaskets. You get a near-new engine that's better than what came out, with a {{warranty}}.

Used engines carry hidden wear, unknown mileage and compatibility risk. A rebuild removes that risk entirely - and more often than not, it works out cheaper than sourcing and fitting a used replacement, both short and long term.

rows.ours: Identified and replaced with updated OEM parts
rows.used: Left as-is (timing chains, injector seals often original)
